subject: Trading
title: Black Swan Events
description: A short lesson to help you apply Black Swan Events.

hook.text: September 11, 2001. COVID-19. The Swiss franc depeg. Events nobody predicted that destroyed 'safe' portfolios.

buildup.text: Nassim Taleb coined 'black swan' for rare, unpredictable events with massive impact that seem obvious afterward.

discovery.text: Normal risk models assume bell-curve distributions. Black swans fall far outside the bell—and happen more often.

twist.text: You can't predict black swans. But you can build portfolios that survive them by limiting max exposure.

climax.text: Never bet the whole account on one idea. The one scenario you didn't model is the one that will occur.

punchline.text: The impossible happens. Be ready for it.

quiz.question: What is a black swan event?
options: A rare, unpredictable event with massive impact
